highlights.label: Silver 步长几乎达到预定非负步长的极限
highlights.text: 任意预定非负步长序列在光滑强凸问题上至少需要 $\Omega(\kappa^{1/p_{\mathrm{sil}}-o(1)}\log(1/\delta))$ 次迭代；这在条件数指数上匹配 Silver 调度，只剩次多项式间隙。

highlights.label: 简单线搜索也能泛型规避严格鞍点
highlights.text: 只在小梯度区域保留上一步步长，Armijo 回溯便可在不要求梯度全局 Lipschitz 的条件下，对几乎所有初点规避严格鞍点；结论还推广到实解析回缩下的黎曼梯度下降。

highlights.label: 在线逆线性优化遗憾降至最优 $O(\sqrt d)$
highlights.text: 多尺度矩阵权重把此前 $O(d)$ 的无时长依赖遗憾降至 $O(\sqrt d)$，与 $T\ge d$ 时的下界匹配；统计维数间隙由此闭合，但总运行时间是否多项式仍待解决。

highlights.label: 随机投影加速｜sketched Anderson 与 GMRES 等价
highlights.text: 在线性无截断情形，同一随机投影内积下的 Anderson 外推点与 sketched GMRES 迭代点逐步一致，为低成本随机历史加速建立了精确 Krylov 桥梁。

highlights.label: 重尾信息年龄｜均值发散仍可收敛
highlights.text: 只需延迟具有某个 $p\in(0,1]$ 阶有限矩，递减步长便能让陈旧信息影响渐近消失；分析覆盖平均信息年龄不存在的异步分布式随机逼近。

highlights.label: 期望约束｜增广拉格朗日获得二阶保证
highlights.text: MESCAL 用随机梯度与 Hessian--向量积求解非凸原始子问题，系统给出期望约束问题达到二阶驻点的外层和样本复杂度。

papers.title: Silver Rate Is (Almost) Optimal for Gradient Descent: The Strongly Convex Case
papers.abstract: We study gradient descent with predetermined nonnegative stepsizes on smooth strongly convex functions. Let $p_{\mathrm{sil}}=\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})$ and $\kappa$ be the condition number. We prove the iteration lower bound $\Omega\left(\kappa^{\frac{1}{p_{\mathrm{sil}}}-o(1)}\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right)$ for both relative squared distance and relative function error, uniformly over $0<\delta<1$ and sufficiently large $\kappa$. This matches the polynomial exponent of $\kappa$ for the Silver stepsize schedule established in [Altschuler and Parrilo, 2025].
papers.summary: 预先固定步长的梯度下降能否仅靠长短步的精细编排，在一般光滑强凸问题上达到比常步长更快的条件数依赖，此前缺少与 Silver 步长上界相匹配的下界。该文对任意非负预定步长序列构造困难实例，证明把相对平方距离或函数误差降至 $\delta$ 至少需要 $\Omega\!\left(\kappa^{1/p_{\mathrm{sil}}-o(1)}\log(1/\delta)\right)$ 次迭代，其中 $p_{\mathrm{sil}}=\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})$。该结果在 $\kappa$ 的多项式指数上匹配已知 Silver 调度上界，只剩次多项式因子；结论限于非负且事先确定的步长，允许负步长的情形仍未闭合。
papers.reason: 最值得读的是它几乎闭合了强凸情形中“只调步长能把梯度下降加速到什么程度”的长期缺口：Silver 调度的非常规指数不再只是一个构造性上界，而被证明在预定非负步长类中基本不可改进。下界同时覆盖距离和函数误差，并明确留下负步长与次多项式间隙，适合作为研究步长编排极限的基准。

papers.title: Gradient descent avoids strict saddles with a simple line-search method too
papers.abstract: It is known that gradient descent (GD) on a $C^2$ cost function generically avoids strict saddle points when using a small, constant step size. However, no such guarantee existed for GD with a line-search method. We provide one for a modified version of the standard Armijo backtracking method with generic, arbitrarily large initial step size. The proof underlines the role of the Luzin $N^{-1}$ property for the iteration maps, and allows to forgo the habitual Lipschitz gradient assumption. We extend this to the Riemannian setting (RGD), assuming the retraction is real analytic (though the cost function still only needs to be $C^2$). In closing, we also improve guarantees for RGD with a constant step size in some scenarios.
papers.summary: 严格鞍点规避的经典证明通常要求固定的小步长，而 Armijo 回溯会随迭代点自适应选步，迭代映射甚至可能不连续，因而不能直接套用稳定流形工具。该文只在梯度范数低于阈值时保留上一步步长，其余时候仍执行标准回溯；对任意 $C^2$ 目标，它证明几乎所有初始步长和几乎所有初点都不会收敛到严格鞍点，不再要求梯度全局 Lipschitz。作者还把结论推广到采用实解析回缩的黎曼梯度下降，并以 Luzin $N^{-1}$ 性质解释零测集在迭代逆像下为何仍可控。
papers.reason: 这项工作补上了“实际常用的自适应线搜索是否仍具有泛型鞍点规避”这一理论空白，而且修改只发生在小梯度区域。证明工具绕开了自适应映射不光滑带来的障碍，对非凸一阶法和黎曼优化的动力系统分析都很有参考价值；边界也很清楚：结论针对严格鞍点，黎曼情形需要实解析回缩。

papers.title: From Frequentist to Bayesian Contextual Optimization
papers.abstract: In data-driven contextual stochastic optimization, existing approaches are predominantly frequentist: they commit to a single predictive model and treat it as ground truth, yielding prescriptions that are fragile to model uncertainty and sampling variability in small- and moderate-sample regimes. We propose Bayesian contextual optimization (BCO), a framework that maintains a Gibbs posterior over the parameter space. This decision-focused posterior weights candidate models by their empirical decision quality rather than statistical fit, thereby avoiding commitment to a potentially misspecified likelihood while encoding the full distribution of plausible models consistent with the data. A Bayesian contextual policy is then derived by minimizing the expected decision cost under the posterior predictive distribution, hedging prescriptions against model uncertainty by aggregating over the posterior. We establish three theoretical guarantees: (i) the Gibbs posterior concentrates exponentially fast around the frequentist best-in-class parameter set; (ii) BCO can strictly improve over the frequentist best-in-class policy when model uncertainty is non-negligible; and (iii) BCO attains an $O(n^{-1/2})$ excess risk rate against the oracle over all probability measures up to a misspecification term and an oracle aggregate gap. Computationally, we tailor a variational inference scheme that has the same per-iteration cost as frequentist alternatives and a gradient-free Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that handles nondifferentiable problems. Numerical experiments on two-stage shipment planning, contextual newsvendor, and return-constrained portfolio problems confirm that BCO consistently reduces out-of-sample cost and variance relative to kernel estimators and decision-focused baselines, with the most pronounced gains in small- and moderate-sample regimes under substantial model uncertainty.
papers.summary: 数据驱动情境随机优化通常先拟合一个预测模型，再把它当成真实分布求决策，因此有限样本下的模型不确定性不会传递到处方。该文提出 Bayesian Contextual Optimization，以经验决策损失而非统计似然构造 Gibbs 后验，并在后验预测分布下联合优化决策。理论上，后验以指数速度集中到频率学派的类内最优参数集；当模型不确定性不可忽略时，聚合策略可严格优于单一类内最优模型；相对所有概率测度上的 oracle，超额风险为 $O(n^{-1/2})$，另含模型错设项与 oracle 聚合间隙。实现同时覆盖可微的变分推断和不可微问题的 Metropolis--Hastings。
papers.reason: 推荐关注它把“预测模型的不确定性”直接纳入随机优化决策，而不是只给预测器加一个贝叶斯外壳。集中性、有限样本决策界和可计算实现连成一条完整链条，尤其适合检视小中样本下 estimate-then-optimize 的脆弱性；需要注意，机会约束的正式理论界仍未在本文闭合。

papers.title: Distributed Stochastic Approximation Algorithms and Heavy-Tailed Age of Information
papers.abstract: Algorithms in multi-agent systems such as federated learning, mobile robotic swarming, and consensus control can be designed and analyzed as distributed stochastic approximation algorithms. Such algorithms involve information exchanges between agents for various computations. The freshness of the information can be quantified using the Age of Information (AoI) metric. Consider robotic teams operating in highly obstructed geographical settings, such as subterranean or dense urban environments. Because of spatial disconnections, AoI has empirically been observed to be heavy-tailed with unbounded moments. However, most analyses assume AoI with bounded moments, creating a gap between theory and practice. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first analysis under general heavy-tailed AoI with potentially infinite mean. We study the stability (almost sure boundedness of the distributed iterates) and convergence of multi-agent systems that are strictly dissipative in the scaling limit (system at 'infinity'). Examples include most gradient-based and consensus algorithms under the Robbins-Monro step-size regime.
papers.summary: 异步分布式随机逼近的现有分析通常要求通信延迟有界或至少具有有限均值，但遮挡环境中的信息年龄可能呈重尾，甚至均值发散。该文只要求延迟支配变量存在某个 $p\in(0,1]$ 阶有限矩，在 Robbins--Monro 步长、Lipschitz 动力、状态相关二阶矩受控的鞅差噪声以及无穷远尺度上严格耗散等条件下，证明延迟相对算法时间轴的影响渐近消失，迭代几乎处处有界，并收敛到极限 ODE 的闭连通内部链传递不变集。结果覆盖均值无穷的 AoI，而非把极端陈旧信息截断为有界延迟。
papers.reason: 这篇论文直接触及异步分布式优化分析中最常被理想化的延迟假设：即使平均信息年龄不存在，递减步长仍可能吸收陈旧信息的累积误差。其缩放 ODE 与稳定性论证对研究随机延迟、间歇连接和异步共识很有价值；保证依赖 $1/(n+1)$ 型步长及无穷远严格耗散，不应外推到任意恒步长系统。

papers.title: Accelerated primal-dual dynamics and algorithms for convex optimization with nonlinear inequality constraints
papers.abstract: We consider convex optimization with nonlinear inequality constraints and develop a primal-dual multiplier framework that is consistent in continuous and discrete time. We first propose continuous-time dynamics with Nesterov-type vanishing damping $\alpha/t$, together with compatible extrapolations of the dual variable and the nonlinear constraint mapping. Under convexity assumptions and $\alpha\geq3$, we establish $\mathcal O(t^{-2})$ convergence rates for both nonlinear feasibility and the objective residual. In the noncritical regime $\alpha>3$, with an admissible choice of the extrapolation parameter, we further prove that the entire primal-dual trajectory converges to a KKT pair and sharpen both continuous-time estimates to $o(t^{-2})$. We then derive an inexact accelerated primal-dual algorithm through a compatible discretization of a perturbed version of the dynamic. For composite convex objectives, a weighted summability condition on the primal inexactness yields $\mathcal O(k^{-2})$ rates for feasibility and the objective residual. In the corresponding noncritical regime, the discrete primal-dual sequence converges to a KKT pair and both residual estimates improve to $o(k^{-2})$. Thus the continuous and discrete results exhibit matching accelerated rates and matching asymptotic improvements. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first Nesterov-type primal-dual multiplier framework for convex optimization with nonlinear inequality constraints.
papers.summary: 非线性凸不等式约束下，如何让 Nesterov 惯性、乘子更新与可离散化结构同时兼容并不直接。该文在连续时间中耦合 $\alpha/t$ 阻尼、外推对偶变量和非线性约束的切向外推；当 $\alpha\geq3$ 时，目标残差和可行性残差均为 $O(t^{-2})$。在 $\alpha>3$ 且外推参数满足给定区间时，整条原始--对偶轨迹收敛到 KKT 对，残差改善为 $o(t^{-2})$。相容离散化允许复合非光滑目标和加权可和的原始子问题误差，并给出对应的 $O(k^{-2})$ 与非临界情形的 $o(k^{-2})$ 结果。
papers.reason: 亮点是连续动力学和离散算法共享同一乘子加速机制，并同时控制非线性可行性与目标误差，而不是只得到遍历界。完整序列收敛和 little-o 改进也比单纯的 $O(k^{-2})$ 更细；当前复杂度只计外层迭代，尚未把非线性原始子问题的求解代价纳入总 oracle 复杂度。

papers.title: A Robust Perceptron Cycling Theorem and Applications
papers.abstract: The classical perceptron cycling theorem of Block and Levin bounds correction sequences whose selected updates come from a finite set and have nonpositive inner product with the current state. We prove a robust variant for additive trajectories $z_{k+1}=z_k+u_k$, for all integers $k\geq0$, with increments in a finite set $U\subset E$, where $E$ is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space and $0\in\operatorname{conv} U$. Let $A\colon E\to E$ have positive-definite symmetric part, without requiring symmetry, and let $B\geq0$. If each $u_k$ is a $B$-approximate minimizer of $u\mapsto\langle Az_k,u\rangle$ over $U$, then $\sup_{k\geq0}\lVert z_k\rVert\leq C(1+\lVert z_0\rVert+B)$, with $C=C(E,U,A)$ independent of the initial state, $B$, and all admissible update choices. We derive two algorithmic consequences. The first is an $O(k^{-1})$ last-iterate norm bound for harmonic vertex-returning Frank--Wolfe for affine strongly monotone variational inequalities on polytopes with relatively interior solutions. It extends the quadratic Frank--Wolfe/herding guarantee of Bach, Lacoste-Julien, and Obozinski to nonsymmetric affine operators. The second consequence concerns oblique relaxation for linear inequalities. Greedy corrections through a fixed matrix with positive-definite symmetric part remain bounded even for inconsistent systems. In particular, for a square matrix $G$ with positive-definite symmetric part, repeatedly increasing the coordinate corresponding to a most-violated inequality of $Gx\geq b$ terminates at an exactly feasible point after finitely many unit corrections. This remains true under bounded additive selection errors, provided the stopping test uses the true inequalities.
papers.summary: 经典感知机循环定理只处理欧氏内积下的精确可接受更新。该文考虑有限更新集 $U$、$0\in\operatorname{conv}U$ 和非必对称但对称部分正定的线性变换 $A$；只要每次更新在分数 $\langle Az_k,u\rangle$ 上是加性误差不超过 $B$ 的近似最小值，就有统一界 $\sup_k\lVert z_k\rVert\leq C(1+\lVert z_0\rVert+B)$。由此作者得到多面体上仿射强单调 VI 的 harmonic vertex-returning Frank--Wolfe 末迭代 $O(k^{-1})$ 界，并证明一类斜松弛线性不等式修正即使面对不一致系统也保持有界；只有强制性而非单调性时可出现发散。
papers.reason: 推荐看一个看似离散的循环定理如何统一解释 Frank--Wolfe、herding 和线性不等式修正的稳定性，并把误差、延迟和量化通过同一个 $B$ 参数纳入界中。非对称强制算子的扩展和明确反例共同说明了哪些结构真正支撑有界性。

papers.title: Stochastic Augmented Lagrangian Framework with Second-Order Convergence Guarantees for Nonconvex Expectation-Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose and analyze an augmented Lagrangian framework for solving stochastic nonconvex optimization problems with expectation-based equality constraints over a closed and convex constraint set. The framework generates a sequence of nonconvex primal subproblems, which are solved inexactly using stochastic second-order methods. We establish iteration complexity results for obtaining approximate second-order stationary points, both in expectation and with prescribed probability, under corresponding conditions on the accuracy of the primal subproblem solutions. We further establish sample complexity results for the framework with general stochastic second-order subproblem solvers under reasonable assumptions on their theoretical guarantees. Moreover, we incorporate three existing stochastic second-order solvers and derive the corresponding deterministic and probabilistic sample complexity results for obtaining approximate second-order stationary points. To the best of our knowledge, such sample complexity guarantees for obtaining approximate second-order stationary points in nonconvex expectation-constrained optimization have not been established previously. Finally, we demonstrate the empirical performance of the proposed framework on two nonconvex machine learning problems.
papers.summary: 随机非凸期望约束问题中，已有方法多停留在近似一阶驻点，难以排除负曲率鞍点。该文提出随机增广拉格朗日框架 MESCAL，把期望等式约束问题分解为一系列非凸原始子问题，并用只需随机函数、梯度和 Hessian--向量积的随机二阶求解器近似处理。作者分别针对期望意义和给定成功概率定义二阶驻点精度，推导外层迭代复杂度；再以一般随机二阶子求解器的保证为接口给出样本复杂度，并实例化到三种现有求解器。结论依赖闭凸外约束、二阶光滑性及相应估计器和子问题精度条件。
papers.reason: 它把增广拉格朗日的约束处理与随机负曲率搜索接上，首次系统给出期望约束非凸问题达到二阶驻点的样本复杂度，而非只证明一阶收敛。通用子求解器接口也便于比较不同随机二阶内核的代价，是研究随机约束优化复杂度的一份有用框架。

papers.title: Tight Regret Bound for Online Inverse Linear Optimization via Multiscale Matrix Weights
papers.abstract: We study online inverse linear optimization with a fixed unknown linear utility: in each round, an environment presents a compact action set, the learner recommends an action from it, and the environment returns an action that maximizes the utility over the same set. When the utility vector and the actions lie in the $d$-dimensional Euclidean unit ball, we give a randomized algorithm whose regret---the cumulative utility shortfall relative to optimal actions---is $O(\sqrt{d})$ in expectation for every time horizon, without knowledge of the horizon. The dependence on $d$ is optimal up to a constant factor by the known $\Omega(\sqrt{d})$ lower bound for horizons $T\ge d$. Our algorithm maintains matrix multiplicative weights on polynomial feature spaces at geometrically spaced scales. It selects a recommendation distribution by solving a linear program and updates its score matrices by comparing the available actions with the feedback action. With rational oracle outputs and feedback actions, an implementation computable relative to a linear-optimization oracle preserves the $O(\sqrt{d})$ regret bound. Whether the same rate is attainable with running time polynomial in the dimension, horizon, and input length remains open.
papers.summary: 在线逆线性优化只观察环境返回的最优动作，不得到未知线性效用的数值。该文在效用向量和动作均位于 $d$ 维单位球、动作集可随历史自适应变化且允许并列最优的条件下，用多尺度多项式特征上的矩阵乘法权重构造随机推荐策略；对任意未知时长，期望累积遗憾统一为 $O(\sqrt d)$。已知下界在 $T\ge d$ 时为 $\Omega(\sqrt d)$，因此维数依赖达到常数意义下的最优。对有理 oracle 输出可给出每轮终止的线性优化 oracle 实现，但尚未证明总运行时间为多项式。
papers.reason: 这篇论文把此前 $O(d)$ 的无时长依赖上界降到与下界匹配的 $O(\sqrt d)$，解决了在线逆优化中最核心的维数间隙。值得特别留意多尺度矩阵权重如何把动作比较编码进多项式特征；同时，统计最优性与计算多项式性之间仍有明确缺口。

papers.title: Private Decentralized Optimization with Noise Reduction and Bias Correction
papers.abstract: Private decentralized learning is affected by sampling noise, privacy noise, and decentralized bias under heterogeneous data. We propose Private Recursive Decentralized Optimization (PRDO). PRDO uses recursive estimation with same-batch gradient differences to reduce estimation errors caused by sampling and privacy noise, while its Exact Diffusion component corrects decentralized bias arising from data heterogeneity. Our analysis establishes a nonconvex convergence bound without assuming uniformly bounded data heterogeneity across nodes. It further gives a sufficient condition under which recursive gradient differences yield strictly lower query sensitivity than private Exact Diffusion, together with an example that rigorously satisfies this condition. Experiments show improved accuracy over the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary: 去中心化学习同时受到随机采样误差、差分隐私噪声和异质数据造成的网络偏差影响。该文提出 PRDO：同一小批量上的递归梯度差抵消采样波动并降低新查询的灵敏度，Exact Diffusion 的适应--修正--混合步骤则消除异质性偏差，每轮只交换一个模型维向量。分析给出非凸驻点界，分离初始异质性、采样噪声和隐私噪声项，且不要求各节点数据异质性统一有界；作者还给出递归查询灵敏度严格低于私有 Exact Diffusion 的充分条件与满足该条件的构造例。
papers.reason: 推荐点在于它没有把隐私噪声和去中心化偏差分开处理，而是同时利用递归估计与 Exact Diffusion，清楚展示二者在界中的不同作用。对隐私分布式优化而言，取消统一异质性上界并给出可验证的灵敏度改进条件，比单纯报告实验精度更具方法价值。

papers.title: Polyak-Type Extragradient Methods for Monotone Root-Finding Problems
papers.abstract: We study Polyak-type step-size selection for extragradient methods for solving deterministic and stochastic monotone root-finding problems. We show that the known projection-type correction for deterministic extragradient arises from minimizing an upper bound on the distance to a solution, paralleling the classical Polyak step-size construction. Using this viewpoint, we provide a unified deterministic analysis of the Polyak-type Extragradient Method (PolyakEG), based on a local critical condition controlling the variation of operator $F$ along the extrapolation direction. This analysis does not require global Lipschitz continuity, and covers sublinear convergence under broader conditions such as Hölder continuity or $(L_0, L_1)$-Lipschitzness and linear convergence under additional strong monotonicity, all through a single framework. We then study the stochastic extensions of this approach. We first prove convergence of a direct stochastic variant, PolyakSEG, when all stochastic component operators share a common solution. We also show that, without this condition, PolyakSEG with nonvanishing step-sizes may fail to converge to a zero of the mean operator. To address this limitation, we propose DecPolyakSEG, which combines decreasing step-sizes with Polyak-type updates, and establish a sublinear residual convergence result without requiring a common solution across the component operators. These results parallel recent developments in stochastic Polyak step-sizes from the convex minimization literature and establish an analogous research avenue in the broader root-finding regime.
papers.summary: 该文把 extragradient 的投影型修正重新解释为“最小化一步距离上界”的 Polyak 步长，并据此统一确定性与随机单调求根。确定性 PolyakEG 只需沿外推方向控制算子变化的局部临界条件，无需全局 Lipschitz；框架同时覆盖 Hölder 与 $(L_0,L_1)$-Lipschitz 算子，在单调情形给子线性残差界、强单调时给线性收敛，并提供无需预知正则常数的回溯版本。随机 PolyakSEG 在各样本算子共享根时收敛；作者也给出无共享根且步长不衰减时的失败例，并以递减步长 DecPolyakSEG 在轨迹局部化条件下获得 $O(K^{-1/2})$ 期望平方残差。
papers.reason: 最有价值的是 Polyak 原理从凸最小化迁移到一般单调求根后，不仅解释既有修正式，还自然暴露了随机扩展何时会失败。统一的局部正则分析、回溯实现和反例使它对变分不等式、极小极大与随机算子算法都具有直接借鉴意义。

papers.title: Relative Primal--Dual Gap Certificates for Operator-Composite Trust-Region Methods
papers.abstract: We study trust-region minimization of a smooth, possibly nonconvex functional plus a convex functional composed with a bounded linear operator. A relative primal--dual gap condition controls both the error in an approximate proximal-gradient step and its linear-model decrease. Together with a computable absolute stationarity test, it yields a finite Cauchy search, convergence of the proximal stationarity measure to zero, and an $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ bound on outer trials. The outer analysis allows the linear operator to take values in a Banach space and does not require dual attainment. When the operator takes values in a Hilbert space and the regularizer is finite and Lipschitz, the dual proximal-gradient method produces finite gaps tending to zero, provided the required proximal maps and functional values can be evaluated. We prove $O(j^{-1})$ gap bounds for both recovered and averaged primal candidates and give a sharper bound on the primal error for exactly recovered points. A semilinear elliptic control problem with unsmoothed total-variation regularization and an $L^2$ control cost illustrates the method in the full $H^1$ metric. Across five meshes, outer and state Newton counts remain constant, while interior-point iteration counts vary mildly.
papers.summary: 算子复合正则项 $R(Tw)$ 的近端映射往往不能精确求，而仅看内迭代差值又不足以保证信赖域模型下降。该文为“光滑非凸项 + 有界线性算子后的凸正则项”建立相对原始--对偶间隙证书：证书同时控制近似近端梯度步误差和线性模型下降，配合绝对驻点测试可保证 Cauchy 搜索有限、近端驻点度量趋零，并给出 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 外层试探次数。外层允许算子值域为 Banach 空间且不要求对偶解取到；Hilbert 值域和有限 Lipschitz 正则项下，内层恢复点与平均点的间隙为 $O(j^{-1})$。
papers.reason: 这项工作提供了一个可计算的内层停止证书，把近端子问题精度真正连接到非凸信赖域外层的下降和复杂度，而不是依赖不可核验的精确近端。对 PDE 约束和总变差正则尤其有用；它也明确指出指标正则时必须用可行原始点，且分析假设光滑量精确计算。

papers.title: ZO-COSMO: Index-Free One-Hop Mixing for Decentralized Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.abstract: Sparse communication in decentralized zeroth-order learning requires compatible peer-state coordinates. We characterize this one-hop condition and develop ZO-COSMO, coupling two-query estimation with average-preserving masked consensus using $q$ values per active link. Global supports serve all-neighbor mixing; matching updates require agreement only within each pair. We derive a sharp contraction-per-scalar bound within the matching class and convergence guarantees for the core and sparse-momentum updates. At fixed matching, exact moment identities characterize how shared directions preserve gradient-heterogeneity cancellation and redistribute estimation error and disagreement. Mechanism experiments cover unequal curvatures, noise, and sparse momentum. Further tests span $64$ synthetic agents and eight logical Qwen LoRA workers. At matched payload budgets, Qwen2-7B QNLI gains $3.65$ accuracy points over explicit-index Rand-$k$; edge-local updates gain $3.42$ and $2.53$ points over all-neighbor mixing on eight-worker complete and ring graphs. A matched-first-step ablation gives a $3.92$-point momentum benefit. Seed-aware and same-matching controls distinguish encoding, scheduling, and query correlation.
papers.summary: 去中心化零阶优化若只传稀疏数值而不传坐标索引，节点必须能从公共随机性恢复与一跳混合兼容的支持集。该文先给出任意当前邻居状态可精确混合的充要支持条件，再提出 ZO-COSMO：全局公共支持服务全邻居混合，匹配调度则让每条活跃边只传 $q$ 个数值。作者在匹配类内给出单位标量通信量的尖锐收缩界，并分别分析核心与稀疏动量版本的收敛；精确矩恒等式进一步分解共享方向对梯度异质性抵消、估计误差与一致性误差的影响。
papers.reason: 它抓住了稀疏通信中常被忽略的“索引本身也有成本”问题，并把编码兼容性、图混合和零阶估计放在同一分析里。对大模型或高维黑箱分布式优化，按每个传输标量衡量收缩而非只数通信轮次，是很实用的比较视角。

papers.title: Safe learning-based control via function-based uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification is essential when deploying learning-based control methods in safety-critical systems. This is commonly realized by constructing uncertainty tubes that enclose the unknown function of interest, e.g., the reward and constraint functions or the underlying dynamics model, with high probability. However, existing approaches for uncertainty quantification typically rely on restrictive assumptions that encode smoothness properties of the unknown function, such as a known norm in a function space. Moreover, these methods usually struggle with discontinuities. In this paper, we model the unknown function as a random function from which independent and identically distributed realizations can be generated. We then construct uncertainty tubes via the scenario approach that hold with high probability. Our uncertainty tubes rely solely on sampled realizations and can therefore accommodate discontinuities represented by the sampling model. We integrate these uncertainty tubes into a safe Bayesian optimization algorithm with which we safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.
papers.summary: 安全贝叶斯优化常依赖已知 RKHS 范数等光滑性先验，面对不连续奖励或约束时覆盖保证会变得脆弱。该文把未知对象建模为可独立采样实现的随机函数，用经典 scenario approach 和 wait-and-judge 支持场景构造全域高概率不确定性管，不额外要求函数平滑；在非空初始安全集存在时，安全 BO 只从下置信界高于阈值的集合选点，给出每轮约束满足的双层概率保证。作者在真实 Furuta 摆上调参，并用 Haar 基函数示例展示对不连续函数的覆盖。
papers.reason: 对安全关键优化而言，关键进展是把安全证书的结构假设从“函数必须足够光滑”换成“随机函数生成模型能产生独立实现”，从而容纳采样模型中的不连续性。场景数、置信度与每轮安全保证的关系明确；实际使用时仍须审查随机函数模型和初始安全集是否可信。

papers.title: Linear convergence rate analysis of Proximal-Tracking for nonsmooth distributed optimization
papers.abstract: Proximal-Tracking is a novel algorithm proposed in [Falsone and Prandini, Automatica, 135 (2022), 109938] for nonsmooth distributed consensus optimization with local set constraints. The global convergence and numerical behavior of Proximal-Tracking have been well studied in [Falsone and Prandini, Automatica, 135 (2022), 109938]. As a complement, in this paper we provide a theoretical analysis regarding its linear convergence rate under additional strong convexity and calmness assumptions. In particular, this analysis does not require assumptions such as differentiability or smoothness, thus preserving the original advantages of the algorithm.
papers.summary: Proximal-Tracking 已能处理每个节点具有局部集合约束的非光滑分布式一致优化，但此前只有全局收敛性，缺少速率刻画。该文把算法改写为与 EXTRA 相关的等价形式，在局部目标强凸、相关集合值映射满足 calmness 等条件下证明线性收敛，同时仍不要求目标可微、光滑或 Lipschitz。作者还说明同一思路可用于带等式与不等式耦合约束的 Augmented Lagrangian Tracking，并给出满足度量正则条件的一类复合结构。
papers.reason: 推荐点是它补齐了 Proximal-Tracking 的速率理论，同时保留该算法处理非光滑局部约束的优势。对分布式近端与梯度跟踪研究，等价 EXTRA 表述和 calmness 如何进入误差界值得细看；线性速率不是无条件结论，强凸性与正则性假设是核心。

papers.title: An Equivalence result for sketched Anderson Acceleration and sketched GMRES
papers.abstract: In this paper we present an equivalence result between a randomized version of Anderson Acceleration and of randomized GMRES for linear problems. Namely, we extend the classical result of Walker and Ni (2011) to the case in which the least-squares problem in Anderson Acceleration is solved in a sketched space defined by a random projection. This equivalence suggests potential avenues for further research in the design and analysis of randomized acceleration methods.
papers.summary: 经典结果表明，对线性不动点迭代，未截断 Anderson acceleration 与 GMRES 共享 Krylov 信息。该文把两边的最小二乘问题都放到同一随机投影定义的 sketched 内积中，证明在相同初值、匹配深度且 GMRES 残差不停滞的标准条件下，第 $k$ 步 Anderson 外推点与第 $k$ 个 sketched GMRES 迭代点一致。证明不依赖 Krylov 基如何构造或正交化，因此覆盖不同的 sketched GMRES 实现；数值实验验证两条残差轨迹相合。
papers.reason: 这项等价把 Anderson acceleration 的历史残差组合与随机化 Krylov 求解器精确连接起来，为设计低成本、可解释的随机历史信息加速提供了理论桥梁。当前结论针对线性问题和无截断情形，有限记忆以及非线性不动点仍是后续问题。
